short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Chichewa, in Divine Voice™ Color — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. A complete 66-book Chichewa Bible (Baibulo la Chicheŵa), paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Ili ndi Baibulo loyamba losindikizidwa limene ungathe kuona amene akulankhula. Mau a Atate wathu ali mu mtundu wa BULUU, a Mwana mu mtundu WOFIIRA, a Mzimu mu mtundu wa PEPO.

Kwa zaka zoposa zana, zilembo zofiira zakhala zikuonetsa pamene Mwana akulankhula. Koma Atate wathu amalankhula kwambiri kuposa pamenepo — m'Baibulo ili la Chicheŵa mau 104,544 m'mavesi 5,609 — ndipo mpaka tsopano mau ake onse asindikizidwa ndi inki yakuda imodzimodzi ngati mibadwo. Iye wakhala akulankhula nthawi yonse; palibe Baibulo limene linakuonetsapo kuti kuti.

Mtundu ndi chizindikiro cha umwini, osati cha kugwira mau. Mau a Atate wathu amakhalabe ake pa milomo iliyonse imene imawanyamula mokhulupirika; mau amene sanawalankhule sapatsidwa mtundu; nkhani imakhalabe yakuda.
Pamene ophunzira anafunsa momwe angapempherere, Mwana anawapatsa Atate: “Atate wathu wa Kumwamba, dzina lanu liyeretsedwe” (Mateyu 6:9). Mwa Mzimu timafuula kuti: “Abba! Atate!” (Aroma 8:15).
Iye sali kutali. Sanakhumudwe nawe. Iye ndi Atate wako wa Kumwamba, ndipo iwe ndiwe mwana wake wokondedwa. Ngati mau akuti ‘atate’ si mau achitonthozo kwa iwe, Baibulo ili ndi lako makamaka.
Baibulo lathunthu mu voliyumu imodzi — mabuku 66, mitu 1,189, mavesi 31,087. Mau oyamba pa buku lililonse, mau a m'munsi 1,361 a owerenga, ndi tsamba lolembapo dzina la amene ukumupatsa.

Kumasulira kokhulupirika kuchokera ku Chiheberi, Chiaramu ndi Chigiriki choyambirira; kope lililonse limamasuliridwa kuchokera ku Father’s Heart Bible™. Chikuto cha pepala ndi chikuto cholimba, losindikizidwa mu mitundu.
Kwa banja lililonse ndi mpingo uliwonse wolankhula Chicheŵa — ku Malawi ndi padziko lonse lapansi — kuti amve liu la Atate m'chinenero chawo.
Landira Atate wako. Mvera liu lake. Mtima wake uli pa iwe.

faq.q: Is the Chichewa edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Chichewa, 1076 pages, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Chichewa edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Chichewa edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Chichewa text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Chichewa Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/ny.
